page.overview:
What is Montenevera?

The Pokémon Center is located near the north exit of the town. The player can heal their Pokémon, buy and sell items, create TMs, and exchange TM Materials for LP in the Pokémon Center.

Potion IX sprite; Potion; 200 Super Potion IX sprite; Super Potion; 700 Hyper Potion IX sprite; Hyper Potion; 1,500 Max Potion IX sprite; Max Potion; 2,500 Full Restore IX sprite; Full Restore; 3,000 Poké Ball IX sprite; Poké Ball; 200 Great Ball IX sprite; Great Ball; 600 Ultra Ball IX sprite; Ultra Ball; 800 Heal Ball IX sprite; Heal Ball; 300 Net Ball IX sprite; Net Ball; 1,000 Repeat Ball IX sprite; Repeat Ball; 1,000 Nest Ball IX sprite; Nest Ball; 1,000 Luxury Ball IX sprite; Luxury Ball; 3,000 Dive Ball IX sprite; Dive Ball; 1,000 Quick Ball IX sprite; Quick Ball; 1,000 Dusk Ball IX sprite; Dusk Ball; 1,000 Timer Ball IX sprite; Timer Ball; 1,000 Antidote IX sprite; Antidote; 200 Burn Heal IX sprite; Burn Heal; 200 Ice Heal IX sprite; Ice Heal; 200 Awakening IX sprite; Awakening; 200 Paralyze Heal IX sprite; Paralyze Heal; 200 Full Heal IX sprite; Full Heal; 200 Revive IX sprite; Revive; 2,000 Poké Doll IX sprite; Poké Doll; 300

North of the Pokémon Center is a person with an Abomasnow who, when spoken to, can Hyper Train any Pokémon with a level of 50 or more using a Bottle Cap or a Gold Bottle Cap. The Hyper Trained Pokémon will have one or all of its stats' IVs maxed, depending on the type of the Bottle Cap used.

The Montenevera branch of the Chansey Supply chain can be found near the southeast exit of the town. This shop provides items for use on Pokémon.
